rationale: Builds on the current staged reverse-tail best by spending the remaining artifact headroom on the value path used by both recurrent tail blocks. Earlier value-path reallocations had to trade away other FP16 rescue, but this is additive: last-two projection rescue, tail QK rescue, quant-aware roundtrips, and EMA finalization are left intact while the penultimate recurrent c_v matrix now survives export in FP16. This directly targets final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb with no hot-loop shape change and trims a redundant final-block-only V keep branch.
title: Additive Recurrent-Tail V FP16 Keep
